source.license_note: Real upstream VictoriaMetrics optimization PR #10468; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up the metricID cache lookup path so Has/Set pick a shard without the per-call fastHashUint64 hashing and dynamic-length slice indirection, without changing cache behavior.
task.instructions: Optimize the lib/storage metricID cache for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkMetricIDCache_Has measures the read path; existing TestMetricIDCache tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: metricIDCache.Has/Set select a shard via fastHashUint64(metricID) % len(c.shards) over a dynamically-sized shard slice, adding hashing and slice-length indirection to a hot cache lookup.

ops_fault.description: The metricID cache shard count is a runtime-sized slice and each Has/Set call computes fastHashUint64(metricID) before a modulo over len(shards) on the ingestion lookup path.
detection_keywords: metricID cache Has on hot path

visible_context.issue_text: Selecting a shard in the metricID cache on every Has/Set call goes through fastHashUint64 and a modulo over a dynamically-sized shard slice, which adds avoidable work to a hot ingestion lookup path.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR; no fabricated profile numbers.
